title_sq: Prane Gjimnazit "Andon Zako Cajupi", Shitet Ambient Biznesi Ne Katin Zero!!
description_sq: Afer Gjimnazit "Andon Zako Cajupi" dhe rruges "Kongresi i Manastirit" Shitet Ambient Biznesi!! Ambienti ndodhet ne katin zero te nje pallati te ri te mireadmnistruar me ashensor dhe organizohet si nje ambient openspace dhe tualeti. Ambienti ka fasade xhami qe i jep mundesi reklamimi per biznesin. Orientimin e ka Jug-Perendim. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: Near the "Andon Zako Cajupi" Gymnasium, Business Space for Sale on the Ground Floor!!
description_en: Close to the "Andon Zako Cajupi" Gymnasium and the "Congresi i Manastir" street, Business premises for sale!! The environment is located on the ground floor of a new, well-managed building with an elevator and is organized as an open space environment and toilet. The environment has a glass facade that gives the possibility of advertising for the business. The orientation is South-West. The property has full mortgage documentation.
